body: MDXViewer plugin chain order is load-bearing (MDXViewer.tsx ~479-485): remark=[remarkGfm, remarkMath, remarkBreaks, remarkCodeMeta]; rehype=[rehypeRaw FIRST, rehypeSlug, rehypeKatex, rehypeGlossary LAST]. rehypeRaw must be first (turns HTML strings into hast before others inspect); rehypeGlossary must be last (walks the fully-built tree incl. katex SVGs+slugs). Do not reorder.
